name: MINH THUAN
bio:
Backend Engineer with 2 years of experience designing and developing scalable, maintainable backend systems.
Proficient in building RESTful APIs, authentication and authorization (JWT, RBAC), database design, and performance optimization across multiple technology stacks.
Experienced with ASP.NET Core, Node.js/NestJS, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Redis, and EF Core, with working knowledge of frontend technologies including React, and React Native.
Passionate about software architecture, clean code, and continuously learning through building real-world products.
